# spoke_service_bindings (Data Source)

Complete bounded discovery of service_bindings in the configured parent scope, using the provisional mock-v5 API. An incomplete or denied page fails the entire read; discovery never mutates services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spoke_service_bindings" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Exact collection target path.
- `items` (Attributes List) Complete snapshot, ordered by opaque ID. An empty list is returned only after complete authorized discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Opaque resource ID.
- `name` (String) Observed display name.
- `revision` (Number) Observed native revision.
- `target_path` (String) Exact scoped resource path.
